notes.subject: נפשה
notes.rationale: נפש ke moya/mafi — mo e swaya ‘yena’, eupša ka Seheberu ke selo se se hemago; ‘moya wa yona’ o be a ka sebeletsa gape

notes.subject: צדקה נפשה
notes.rationale: Ba mofetoledi bangwe ba re ‘o ile a ikannetša’ (geneva, kjv), ba bangwe ba re ‘o ile a itšhupa tsedeke’ (jps) — fela ‘o loka’ le yona e a dumelwa

notes.subject: משבה / מבגדה
notes.rationale: Kgathanong ya mabedi: go boela morao kgathanong le go kgolofatša — e tsweletša kgathanong ya temana 10

translation: Gomme Yahwe a bolela go nna: Yo a boelago morao, Yisraele, o ile a itšhupa tsedeke go feta yo a kgolofago, Yudha.
